about: Public police call data Siren downloads automatically near each city. Add a city: copy an entry, open a pull request. 'history' feeds become traffic-stop hotspots; 'live' feeds show active calls on the map. Siren reads the newest copy of this file from GitHub (main branch) once a day.

feeds.name: New Orleans Police (NOPD)
feeds.where: ((typetext = 'TRAFFIC INCIDENT' AND selfinitiated = 'Y') OR typetext = 'DIRECTED TRAFFIC ENFORCEMENT')
feeds.source: City of New Orleans open data - NOPD calls for service
